ledger.claim: The waiting window runs from the driver's arrival at 09:10:45 to his cancellation at 09:16:05, and inside that window the chat log carries a locating message from the rider: MSG-00405-002, sent 09:11:40, delivered 09:11:41, reading 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. It names the rider's own position (blk 12 void deck), states she cannot see the vehicle, and asks the driver for his position. That is limb (a) of POL-NS-04 satisfied on the face of the record.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied. The 120 second window after 09:11:40 closed at 09:13:40; the driver posted no reply at any point before terminating the trip at 09:16:05, 265 seconds after the message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. The chat export's read receipt shows the driver opened the message at 09:11:55, ten seconds after it was sent, and still did not answer it.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. rider_presence is available with 36 fixes, all 36 of them qualifying, spanning 09:10:45 to 09:16:00 - the whole waiting window - and every one of them lies within the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone pickup (max_distance_m 45.15 m, mean_distance_m 41.01 m, min_distance_m 36.23 m). Not one rider fix falls outside the radius, so the majority-of-qualifying-fixes requirement is met many times over.

With limbs (a), (b) and (c) all made out, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 chargeability is displaced by that clause, and the fare breakdown shows SGD 4.00 charged at 09:16:20 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.00 is returned to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

The driver's statement that he waited over five minutes and that 'she never came down' does not answer POL-NS-04 and is partly contradicted by his own evidence. His trace does confirm the 320 second wait, but the rider's device sits within 45 m of the pickup pin for the entire window, and the driver read the rider's message at 09:11:55 and never told her where he was standing. POL-NS-04 turns on the unanswered locating message, not on the length of the driver's wait.

Nothing on this record diverts the case to human review instead of a ruling. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not trip; those are the only profile fields I cite, and only for the tests POL-GEN-01 names them for. Every artifact the rider's case rests on - chat log, GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on the deciding facts is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not engaged.

I do not press the arithmetic routes, and I concede them. The measured in-geofence dwell is 320 seconds against the 300 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD pickup (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a surplus of 20 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. Nor is the arrival marker false: it is a BUTTON press at 09:10:45, and that timestamp is the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so POL-NS-05's tests - more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker - are not met on this trace. The rider's case rests on POL-NS-04 alone.

The only artifact in this bundle below weight 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-00405-01, the traffic advisory for the pickup road, which is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload): no advisory covers Bedok South Rd in this window. I disclose that impairment. It carries no fact for either side and decides nothing the rider's case rests on; under POL-NS-06 limb (i) its absence merely denies the driver any kerbside-accumulation argument, and the rider does not need the point.

Every limb of POL-NS-01 is made out on this record. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 09:10:45, corroborated by the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notice delivered to the rider at 09:10:46. (b) The driver's trace is already inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second - his closest approach to the pickup pin is 3.7 m and 33 fixes qualify inside the radius - so the clock runs from geofence entry, not from a late tap. (c) He then held position for one continuous 320 second interval, which exceeds the 300 second free waiting period the trip record's own platform_policy carries (not the 180 second default), and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. (d) The trip shows no boarding and was terminated by the driver at 09:16:05, after the required dwell had run, under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. The cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable.

The arrival geofence test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied on the trace itself and not inferred: the pickup zone class is STANDARD, so the radius is 50 m, and the derived arrival block records 33 qualifying fixes inside that radius with a minimum distance of 3.7 m - far more than the three consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires. This is not a driver who sat outside the radius, and because his stationary fixes lie inside the radius rather than between the radius and 400 m, the wrong-entrance regime of POL-NS-03 is not engaged either and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival point against this driver. The fastest speed anywhere on his trace is 10.6 km/h, below the clause's 15 km/h motion threshold, and his closest approach is 3.7 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m line, so the marker at 09:10:45 is true. Consistently with that, dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0: his first in-geofence fix and the marker fall in the same second, so there is no recomputed clock that shortens the dwell.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider no route on these facts: the effective in-geofence dwell is a single unbroken run of 320 seconds against the 300 second minimum for this zone class, and the derived shortfall is minus 20.0 seconds, that is a surplus and not a deficit. There is no premature cancellation, and the full refund that clause would order on a shortfall cannot be ordered here.

The money line carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.00, which is exactly the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip under the resolution rule, and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount the driver asks to stand is the amount the platform itself charged.

On a verified no-show the driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the fee in force: SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 net figure carried by the fare breakdown. The anti-farming check does not trip on the only two fields the clause permits it to read - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate - so compensation is payable rather than withheld, and no escalation follows from that check.

No other escalation ground in POL-NS-09 is shown on the profiles: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and both rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so limbs (c) and (d) are not engaged and nothing in this case requires the fee to be held rather than decided.

The only impaired artifact in the bundle is the traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00405-01, which is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 - I disclose that rather than present it as clean. It bears only on POL-NS-06(i), the limb that permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed when a qualifying advisory covers the pickup road: limb (i) is therefore unavailable on this record, but the driver does not need it, because his 320 second dwell is one continuous run (run_count 1) that requires no accumulation.

The driver does not dispute the chat record: the rider's 09:11:40 message was delivered, read at 09:11:55, and answered neither in the log nor by any in-app call recorded in the trip record, and her own device track stays within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius throughout. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) to (c) are therefore made out on the face of the evidence, and the driver's case rests on his own arrival and dwell arithmetic under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 as set out above, which stand unless the judge finds POL-NS-04 displaces them.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider because POL-NS-04, not the dwell arithmetic, decides this case. The driver's own arrival case is sound and I accept it: he marked 'arrived' at 09:10:45 and the GPS trace puts him 3.7 m from the pickup pin at that same second, with 33 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius; he then held one unbroken 320-second dwell (dwell_start_offset 0.0, run_count 1) against the 300-second free waiting period the trip record's own platform_policy carries; and he cancelled at 09:16:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding. If nothing else were on the record the fee would stand and POL-NS-07 would pay him SGD 3.20. It does not stand, because POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01, which says in terms that no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 leaves the fee standing. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold. (a) At 09:11:40, inside the waiting window (09:10:45 to 09:16:05), the rider sent a message that both named her own position and asked for his: 'im at blk 12 void deck, cant see any car, where r u?'. (b) The driver read it at 09:11:55 and posted no reply at all; the 120-second window closed at 09:13:40 and he terminated at 09:16:05, 265 seconds after the message, with trip_record.in_app_calls empty. (c) Her device track places her within 100 m of the pin across the whole window - 36 of 36 qualifying fixes, maximum 45.15 m, mean 41.01 m, minimum 36.23 m. The rider is therefore exonerated and the SGD 4.00 fee is refunded to her in full, with no driver compensation payable. The driver's remaining claims are answered together. POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-03: accepted - the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, so the wrong-entrance regime and its pin-ambiguity goodwill never engage, but that point does not save the fee. POL-NS-05: accepted - the arrival marker is true, his maximum speed being 10.6 km/h against the 15 km/h test and his closest approach 3.7 m against the 300 m line. POL-NS-06: accepted - the 320-second dwell is a 20-second surplus over the 300-second minimum (derived shortfall -20.0 s), so the premature-cancellation refund gives the rider nothing; her case does not need it. POL-NS-08(d): accepted - fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of 4.00 reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03: rejected - POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-04 does, so there is no SGD 3.20 payout and no DRIVER_COMPENSATION outcome; the fee is not left in place. Nothing escalates: POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0), and the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 120, a rate of 0.008). Every artifact this ruling rests on - EV-CHAT-00405, EV-GPS-00405 and EV-TRIP-00405 - is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not engaged. EV-ADVIS-00405-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); it carries no fact here, nothing in this ruling relies on it, and its absence only denies an accumulation argument under POL-NS-06(i) that neither party needs. No clause produces a referral: the driver selected RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises, so there is no mis-selected code to record. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
